title: VU#685399: PromZard context key code injection leads to remote code execution
description: The npm library promzard versions 4.0.0 and earlier contains a vulnerability that allows remote code execution. This occurs because the library directly interpolates keys from a context object into JavaScript code without sanitization, enabling injection of arbitrary code. An attacker who can control these keys can execute code within the Node.js process running promzard. No official fix or vendor coordination is available; users are advised to strictly validate any data used to populate the context object and avoid passing untrusted keys.
